title: centaurium suffruticosum
intro: Centaurium suffruticosum, commonly known as Mountain centaury, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the gentian family. The health benefits of Mountain centaury include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic activities, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Mountain centaury include iridoids, such as centaurin and gentiopicroside, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
